Name: Matty Cawtorn's Horsey
Author: brie112358
Description: Introducing the "Matty Cawtorn's Horsey" mod for Stardew Valley! Say goodbye to hooves and hello to horsepower with this hilarious twist on your trusty steed. Your horse gets a rugged upgrade, morphing into a shiny Gord G-150! Imagine cruising around Pelican Town in this monster truck, leaving a trail of pixelated exhaust and country tunes in your wake. It's the perfect nod to the country life, truck enthusiasts, and a touch of that good ol' red, white, and blue spirit. Whether you're hauling crops or just joyriding, this mod adds a fun and cheeky twist to your farming adventure! Yeehaw! 🚜🤠🇺🇸
